title: The level of creativity people have blows me away
author: NoushieHere
selftext:
I've heard that with more people using AI to create, it's all going to start looking the same and 'slop' will takeover. I more-so agree with the opinion that creative people will in fact become more creative, and AI has simply broken barriers as to what they can achieve in a short time. The increase in the amount of web-apps is bound to increase, vibe coders will increase, but will we stop consuming each other's content? Nope. That's because everyone may have tools to build but not everyone has the same level of creativity or thought process. Not all projects will be amazing, but a lot of them will be worth seeing.

Recently I ran a hackathon launching [www.whimsi.fun](http://www.whimsi.fun), co hosting it with Lovable in London. It was a haunted themed hack on Halloween where teams had to make spooky themed web-apps. They only had around an hour to build so the quality of the winning team submissions was pretty good, considering the constraint. 

Essentially I started Whimsi because I saw talented people making solid things but due to high marketing and sales costs it gets lost in the void. The idea is to get people earning from what they create.

I'd love to see what everyone else is making, so if you've created something on lovable, vercel, replit, figma etc just drop in your link on our website and our agent will write it up for you. You can also write down what you're in the mood for and we'll show you options. Any and all feedback welcome.

Here's our winning game from the hackathon: [https://whimsi.fun/p/haunted-escape/](https://whimsi.fun/p/haunted-escape/) 

And some personal favourites:

1) Upload your enemy's picture and fight them as a monster: [https://whimsi.fun/p/monster-therapy/](https://whimsi.fun/p/monster-therapy/)

2) Dosa maker: [https://whimsi.fun/p/dosa-maker/](https://whimsi.fun/p/dosa-maker/)

comments.author: GlobalCurry
comments.body: AI is so new I think it's dangerous for people to judge ai game dev by the quick stuff that is put out right now. The real interesting wave of stuff benefited by AI will come in a year or so. Right now you can build games that took several years to make in a few weeks. Just think what can be made in several years now.
